featured_reviews.name: Navnit D (Navin)
featured_reviews.review_text: Had to make a simple Rama tattoo in Samarkan font, in memories of my grandmom who passed away and always use to chant RAMA, so chose top artist/owner here, who earlier was with Aalim, but in true sense high disappointment with Sameer as his focus was big art in parallel on some celebrity so somehow said this is quick one to wrap up, will do now and outcome... screwed this simple piece as well... symmetry is out, uniformity out, shape of few objects out... they said come for touch up, things can be fixed but don't trust or think its that easy... better find a non celebrity oriented place and person who can actually pay attention to your requirement with his expertise and time and interest rather than number. For you its special for then it may be a count. Choose wise! My story is many years back but true! I know "are you a real customer" to all sort of arrogant statements/excuses can fly in defence, rather than genuine acceptance and improvising, but I dont care as it is what it is and damage is done... see the real pic now!
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Hi Navin, we thank you for your feedback and unsolicited advice, Sameer has been tattooing for 26 years now and has an extremely strong portfolio, and is considered amongst the most respected and sought after artist to get a tattoo from in the country, we still welcome his clients from 24 yrs back and all their tattoos are still extremely neat and crisp, we would really like to know which year are you mentioning here? And coming out to leave a review about it now, does seem a little strange.
Also considering we accommodated you along side a celebrity to do a small tattoo (with all due respect to your late grandmom) only goes to show we hold no bias between celebs and average people like you and us. We respect and value every individual who walks into our studio and treat them all and their tattoos with utmost priority.
As humans we expect clients also to cut us some room for minor errors as we are humans and not printing machines. We respected you and requested you to come back if any issues, only means that we value you and the simple job you got done, even though small and simple, we wanted to fix it IF any issues, just to make sure you have the best job.
We understand you didn't feel the need to oblige and thats absolutely fine! we just expect you to act better and not post a negative review after, we dont know how many years.
Thank you and hope you would offer us another unlikely chance to consider your experience a better one :))
Team Kraayonz.

featured_reviews.name: Inkaffinated
featured_reviews.review_text: Got an amazing cover-up done at Kraayonz Tattoo Studio⁠  by Sameer Patange and I’m genuinely impressed with the result. The way he transformed the old tattoo into something clean, detailed, and well-balanced was incredible. Super professional, patient throughout the process, and really understands placement and design flow. The studio vibe was comfortable and hygienic too. Highly recommend for anyone looking for quality tattoo work or cover-ups.

featured_reviews.name: Vikram Agrawal
featured_reviews.review_text:
Hi
Sameer and his team are really amazing. I was unsure about my body art, whether I should do it or not, but after a couple of meetings, particularly after meeting Sameer, I bit the bullet. My design, Yin Yang Japanese Koi Fishes. His team Neha (my artist), Shashwat (my daughter’s artist) and Anujith - all amazing artists, super talented, know their job, wonderful natured and best of all, they don’t sugar coat things. If it’s going to hurt like hell, they will tell you. Plus They are very professional and have a great level of commitment. Many thanks Team for a great job and making this the start of my body art journey.

featured_reviews.name: Vidur Mehta
featured_reviews.review_text: Had an amazing experience designing and getting this tattoo. Had been meaning to get an Arsenal Tattoo for sometime but couldn’t decide on a design because I wanted it to be simple but also different. The idea of including the muffler was awesome and just what I wanted. From the placement to the execution of the red colour everything was perfect. super happy!!

featured_reviews.name: Shweta Rane
featured_reviews.review_text:
Got my second custom tattoo design from them, and it was a great experience once again. Shashwat and Neha were incredibly supportive and friendly throughout the entire process. They patiently made revisions until I was completely satisfied with the design and took the time to answer all my questions. They guided me at every step, ensuring my idea was thoughtfully translated into both the tattoo design and its placement.

Extremely talented and patient artists—thank you for making the experience truly wonderful. I highly recommend this studio and the artists here.

featured_reviews.name: Upansu Baruah
featured_reviews.review_text: got sm fresh ink last month and the line work is literal perfection...the whole energy in the studio is so chill and welcoming..shouts out to the team for being so talented;8

featured_reviews.name: Isha Rajwade
featured_reviews.review_text: Got my first fine-line custom design tattoo from them. My artist Sourabh was incredible. Super kind, friendly and supportive throughout the appointment. I got full freedom in brainstorming about the design, making changes till the time the design felt right. He even superimposed the design on the place where I wanted it to be tattooed so as to get a glimpse of what I’ll be working with. He didn’t rush the process and walked me through it all. In all, I’d highly recommend him for your next tattoo :)

featured_reviews.name: Sanghamitra Sengupta
featured_reviews.review_text: Have gotten three tattoos from here and will continue to come back here for all my future tattoos - extremely dependable artists and professional! Always a treat to be here :)
